messages:
irina: Heads up - just saw a spike in GPU onboarding failures in us-west-2, root cause looks like a new VPC egress deny that landed from the infra hardening PR.
samir: Ugh, which rule? I only saw the FW baseline tighten for 10.2.3 yesterday.
irina: It's the deny to 0.0.0.0/0 from the warm-pool subnet. That breaks the keystore-proxy -> KMS path via NAT, so nodes can't fetch decrypt keys and stay in ProvisioningPending.
maya: Oh, that explains the warmup thrash we saw. GPUs keep rebooting waiting for decrypt.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-23T14:02Z applied firewall/hardening v10.2.3 to us-west-2.
ton y: @irina can you paste the broken connection logs? we need quick rollback steps.
irina: paste: ```
keystore-proxy ERROR: decrypt failed: could not reach 34.231.12.45:443 (connect timeout)
node-join: provisioning -> failed (kms handshake timeout)
``` 
samir: Immediate mitigation: add an allowlist for the keystore-proxy elastic IPs to permit 443 egress until we patch the policy.
maya: Agreed. Can someone grant me permission to edit the fw policy? I can't because of the new role-boundary change.
ton y: I'm on it, pushing a temporary exception via infra-runbooks. Command: `infractl firewall exception create --subnet warm-pool-usw2 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0 --port 443 --reason "keystore egress allowlist temp" --expires 30m`
irina: After exception, nodes recovered almost immediately. We went from 80% failed to 95% healthy in ~4m.
ops-bot: monitor-bot: warm-pool-usw2 healthy_nodes: 12 -> 54 (4m)
samir: Cost note: the repeated reboots and re-warmups added ~6 GPU-hours and pushed a temporary autoscaler spike; estimate extra $1.2k for the window.
maya: We need a playbook so policy changes don't require role edits to patch emergently. Proposal: infra alerts on any fw rule that would block keystore egress and auto-create a short-lived allowlist with audit logging.
ton y: Also we should avoid 0.0.0.0/0 denies that implicitly break NAT pathing. Prefer explicit deny lists with allow-before-deny ordering and a canary rollout.
irina: I'll open a postmortem-focused issue with repro steps, cost delta, and a suggested policy template. Assigning to eng-platform + security to co-own the follow-up.
samir: For immediate follow-up: (1) roll the deny change back and rework rule ordering, (2) add e2e gate to detect KMS handshake failures during fw rollout, (3) add a runbook for ops to create exceptions without needing role changes.
maya: Thanks everyone. Tagging compliance for audit: the temporary exception was created and will be attached to the change record. We'll submit the justification.
irina: Filed: https://issues.internal/RED-12345 "VPC egress deny caused keystore decrypt failures -> warm-pool thrash". Linking logs and cost snapshot.
ton y: Closing thread once we confirm policy revision PR and postmortem.
